en.faqSubtitle: Everything to know before you start.

faq.q: Can we really use Bar Assistant in a commercial bar?
faq.a: Yes. Both the free “Bartender” plan and the paid “Mixologist” plan are fine for venues - Bar Assistant never restricts commercial use, which is why bars, beach clubs and hotels use it.

faq.q: We're a small beach bar, is the free plan enough?
faq.a: For most single-outlet venues, yes. The free plan gives you one bar, up to 750 cocktails, ingredient stock, pour-cost pricing and a public menu. Move to “Mixologist” (up to 10 bars, staff accounts) when you open a second outlet or hire a team.

faq.q: Our staff changes every summer, won't recipes get lost?
faq.a: Recipes live in the app, not in someone's head. Every team member sees the same exact spec, pour by pour. Give bartenders access, keep settings with managers, and you serve the same drink all season.

faq.q: Can guests actually see the menu?
faq.a: Yes, publish the menu to a public URL in one click and put the URL (or a QR code) on a stand or card. When prices or drinks change, update once and guests see the new menu instantly. You can also export and print.

faq.q: What about our data and GDPR?
faq.a: Bar Assistant is developed in EU. We store the minimum personal data needed and host in the EU. The product is open source (MIT) - you can self-host on your own hardware and export your data any time.
Yes, email info@barassistant.app and we'll set up invoice billing for your business.

en.finalTitle: Ready to pour a better season?
en.finalText: Build your first menu on the free plan today - within an hour you'll know whether Bar Assistant fits your bar. Start before the season and open ready.

hr.faqSubtitle: Sve što trebate znati prije nego krenete.

faq.q: Smijemo li doista koristiti Bar Assistant u komercijalnom baru?
faq.a: Da. I besplatni “Bartender” plan i plaćeni “Mixologist” plan prikladni su za Vaše objekte - Bar Assistant nikada ne ograničava komercijalnu upotrebu, zato ga koriste barovi, plažni klubovi i hoteli.

faq.q: Mali smo plažni bar - je li besplatni plan dovoljan?
faq.a: Za većinu objekata s jednim prodajnim mjestom - da. Besplatni plan nudi jedan bar, do 750 koktela, zalihe sastojaka, cijene prema trošku i javni meni. Pređite na “Mixologist” (do 10 barova, računi osoblja) kada otvorite drugo prodajno mjesto ili zaposlite tim.

faq.q: Osoblje nam se mijenja svakog ljeta - neće li se recepti izgubiti?
faq.a: Recepti žive u aplikaciji, ne u nečijoj glavi. Svi članovi tima vide istu točnu recepturu. Barmenima dajte pristup, postavke zadržite kod menadžera i poslužit ćete isto piće cijelu sezonu.

faq.q: Mogu li gosti zaista vidjeti meni?
faq.a: Da - meni jednim klikom objavite na javnoj adresi i tu adresu (ili QR kod) stavite na stalak ili karticu. Kada se cijene ili pića promijene, ažurirate jednom i gosti odmah vide novi meni. Također ga možete izvesti i ispisati.

faq.q: Što je s našim podacima i GDPR-om?
faq.a: Bar Assistant razvija se u Hrvatskoj (EU). Čuvamo minimum potrebnih osobnih podataka i hosting je u EU. Proizvod je otvorenog koda (MIT) - možete ga samostalno hostati na vlastitom hardveru i podatke izvesti u svakom trenutku.
Da - pišite na info@barassistant.app i dogovorit ćemo naplatu računom za vašu tvrtku.

hr.finalText: Postavite svoj prvi meni na besplatnom planu već danas - u roku od sat vremena znat ćete odgovara li Bar Assistant vašem baru. Krenite prije sezone i otvorite spremni.
